name: St. Giles Boulevard
detail: I went to Malaysia to watch a movie, and it was reassuring and convenient that I could enter the hotel through the direct passage from Megamall even after the screening ended around 2 AM. Additionally, at the beryl's shop on the LG floor of Megamall, you get a 10% discount by showing a JAL card or JMB membership card. The room and bathroom were spacious and comfortable. A cleaning boy visits the room around 10 AM. The cleaning may not be perfect, and sometimes the supplies are insufficient. However, overall it has a very clean feel. The front desk staff were kind and friendly, scoring full points. The water system allows you to fill up at a water dispenser near the elevator. If you want to take water with you when going out, be sure to bring your own bottle. For meals, the breakfast buffet available from 6:30 to 10:30 is very delicious. Those looking to enjoy local restaurants may not find satisfaction in the area around the hotel.
area: Mid Valley / Bangsar,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Palette KL Sentral near Pudu LRT formerly RPC Blissful Homes
detail: The location is convenient, about a 10-minute walk from the LRT station. The room is a bit small, but if you consider it just a place to sleep, the atmosphere isn't bad. Points of concern include the lack of a refrigerator in the room, the weak water pressure in the shower, and some slight noise leakage from the neighboring room. On the other hand, the free Wi-Fi was reliable and had decent speed, so researching on my smartphone was comfortable. Additionally, the staff was very kind and reassuring, and the deposit I left at check-in was smoothly returned at check-out. There are some downsides, but personally, I didn’t feel any major inconveniences. If you're someone who wants to keep accommodation costs low while traveling, I think this hotel is definitely a good option.

name: Sunway Pyramid Hotel
detail: The front staff's service was prompt and very friendly, allowing me to feel secure during my stay. The location is also wonderful, being directly connected to a shopping mall, which is really convenient. Even when I returned tired, I was able to rest well in a comfortable room that the cleaning staff had neatly prepared for me, making for a happy stay. In summary, it can only be described as the best! This is a hotel I would definitely like to use again.
area: Bandar Sunway,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Sunway Lagoon Hotel - formerly Sunway Clio Hotel
detail: The overall experience of this stay was very good. The hotel's location is convenient, with plenty of dining options and convenience stores nearby, and traveling around was smooth. The front desk staff were friendly, the check-in process was quick, and they patiently answered any questions. The room was clean and tidy, and the space was larger than expected. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and I slept well at night. The soundproofing was also decent, so outside noise did not disturb my rest. The bathroom was neat, the hot water was stable, and basic toiletries were readily available. Overall, this hotel offers great value for money, making it suitable for both short and long stays. I will consider staying here again the next time I'm in the area, and I recommend it. 👍
area: Bandar Sunway,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Armani Residence and Hotel Kuala Lumpur
detail: I stayed for a total of two nights. It was quite rushed and I had things to do, so I didn't go to the pool area and can't comment on that. However, the room facilities were nice, with all the necessary furniture and appliances, and it was quite clean. I stayed alone, so it was more than enough, but it might be a bit cramped for a family, so it's better to book a larger room. The floor-to-ceiling window offers a view of the Petronas Towers at night, although it's a bit far away. The room was nice, but the hallway leading to the room was a bit empty and poorly decorated, which felt a bit unsettling. The building is quite tall, but there are only three elevators, so the wait time is a bit long. If you're going to the Petronas Towers, walking might take some time, so I recommend taking a taxi since you have to walk along a major road with heavy traffic. Overall, I was satisfied.
area: Kuala Lumpur City Centre,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: Sunway Resort Hotel
detail: I stayed for one night in Kuala Lumpur when visiting family. It has a stable sense of luxury. The staff is kind and attentive. The cookies we received as a service during check-in were delicious. They were slightly warm and brought me joy. The room is spacious and easy to use. It's a hotel you want to stay in forever. The fact that it's adjacent to a mall is also a big plus.
area: Bandar Sunway,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: The Gardens Residences - St. Giles Gardens Residences Kuala Lumpur
detail: What should be evaluated is the presence of a bathtub. It is truly difficult to find a place to stay with a bathtub in Kuala Lumpur. Moreover, being directly connected to the station and an incredible number of restaurants and shops makes it hard to find a more convenient location. There is also a kitchen, making it easy to cook for yourself. The floors of the bathtub and shower are made of marble. It feels like a sophisticated and luxurious facility rather than just heavy. I really like it. The price is quite high, but considering this convenience and the facilities, I think it's understandable. In terms of price, that's what I think. The interior is overall natural, yet refined and beautiful.
area: Mid Valley / Bangsar,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: The Gardens Hotel - St. Giles Mid Valley Kuala Lumpur
detail: The rooms in this hotel are spacious and comfortable. The bathroom is fully equipped, making one feel very relaxed. The transportation is convenient, not only near major attractions, but also with convenient airport transfers, providing an excellent walking experience. The cleanliness of the hotel and the service from the staff are impressive. It is well-equipped, offers great value for money, and overall provides a pleasant stay experience. Highly recommended!
area: Mid Valley / Bangsar,Kuala Lumpur - View on map

name: The Bed Bukit Bintang
detail: The price is reasonable, and I was very grateful for the breakfast buffet. There are plenty of showers, toilets, and sinks, and it feels reasonably clean, but it's a bit inconvenient since it's a little far from the sleeping area. However, the sleeping area is very clean and private, and with the price being so good and the access being close to the downtown area, I'm very satisfied! There's also a pool, and the view is nice. I could also leave my luggage there. Towels are provided. There is a water dispenser available.
